LanguageData.WotF_Elf.description: A slender, long-lived people. Born with a physiology unlike that of ordinary humans, they seem able to call forth a force known as "magic" directly, without any external aid. As for where they truly came from—or why they feel an almost instinctive kinship with forests—even most elves cannot say.
LanguageData.WotF_Elf.label: elf
